8.4.1.9 Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication
[SWS_Nm_00254] Definition of callback function Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndi-
cation
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00359, RS_Nm_02535
⌈
Service Name
Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication
Syntax
void Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication (
NetworkHandleType nmChannelHandle
)
Service ID [hex]
0x1e
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
nmChannelHandle
Identification of the NM-channel
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Sets an indication, when the NM Coordinator Sleep Ready bit in the Control Bit Vector is set
Available via
Nm.h
⌋
[SWS_Nm_00255]
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_00150
⌈Configuration of Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication: Optional
If NmCoordinatorSyncSupport is set to TRUE , the Nm shall provide the API Nm_
CoordReadyToSleepIndication.⌋
